R3-EA-002-D1: Retain the conservative October 1–6, 2019 security-closure segment. September closure references and the announced October 3 reopening conflict with the October 6 continued-closure report; none should be treated as a complete operational chronology.

A March 18, 2020 Medcom report quotes Skouw official Mathilda Pusung giving January 2020 passenger totals: passport and border-pass arrivals and departures. Those counts establish later public crossing during January 2020, so use January 31 only as a conservative month-precision upper bound. This does not assert that the crossing remained open on January 31: a separate COVID closure began late that month. Exact 2019 reopening and intervening continuity remain unknown.
